title: Arizer Replacement Balloon Pack for Extreme Q and XQ2
description:
Elevate your vaping experience with the Arizer Extreme Q Replacement Balloon Pack! This essential accessory pack includes 6 premium, food-grade balloons designed to seamlessly integrate with your Arizer Extreme Q Vaporizer. Each balloon is crafted for durability and optimal vapor delivery, ensuring a flawless session every time. The pack is perfect for replacing old balloons, keeping your sessions fresh and enjoyable. Note that frosted glass mouthpieces and “O”-rings are not included.

Upgrade your vaping setup today with this must-have Arizer Replacement Balloon Pack for the Extreme Q and XQ2 desktop vaporizers.
